mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.created_at AS post_created_at, u.id AS user_id, u.email, u.nickname, u.created_at AS user_created_at FROM users u INNER JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title, p.content, p.created_at AS post_created_at, u.nickname FROM users u INNER JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.user_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content})
